title: padus australis
intro: Padus australis, commonly known as the Black Alder or Mountain Alder, is a deciduous shrub or small tree native to Australia and parts of Asia. The plant has been traditionally used in herbal medicine for its health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Padus australis include wound healing, pain relief, and antiseptic effects, attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. The health benefits of Padus australis also include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and immunomodulatory effects, which may contribute to its potential use in treating various diseases and conditions.
